row.body: The key to the gathering place is wrapped in a burial request; a second note says the crowd count has not changed since the last check.
row.title: A burial request

sidecar.gloss: A burial request and an unchanged crowd count remain together.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program team could have used the same site and key; an unchanged count does not show who was gathered there.

row.body: road dust coats the ball of yarn and hand torch, but their ties are clean and newly cut. the bundle was repacked after travel.
row.title: missing count beside the ball of yarn

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
